svg.text: Modular Monolith Architecture · Shared Next.js API Routes · Domain Services Engine · Prisma Data Access · MongoDB Persistence
Each application is an independent client running on its own port. Frontends communicate strictly through HTTP APIs and NEVER connect to MongoDB directly.
2. SHARED BACKEND API ENTRY, EDGE MIDDLEWARE & AUTHENTICATION BOUNDARY
Unified entry point: Intercepts requests, validates HttpOnly session cookies, resolves identity, verifies RBAC roles, and validates schemas.

g.text: • Inspects session cookies on every route request
• Unauthenticated access to protected routes redirected to /login?from=path
• getAuthenticatedUser(): Validates active candidate DB session
• Strict Company Isolation: where: { companyId: auth.company.id }
• Candidate Resource Ownership: Prevents cross-candidate resume access
• Strict Zod Schemas validate all request payloads before service entry
• Magic-byte signature checking for PDF/DOCX uploads (FileValidationService)
• Rejects invalid payloads early with formatted 400 Bad Request

svg.text: 3. MODULAR BACKEND DOMAIN SERVICES (SHARED BUSINESS LAYER · @backend)
Autonomous business logic services exported from backend/src. Enforces business invariants, atomic transactions, and failure rollbacks.

g.text: Session lookup, credentials verify, bcrypt (12 rounds)
Recruiter token verify, company membership hydration
Mentor credentials, status verification, active check
Admin session verify & administrative permission checks
Generates 32B crypto tokens, SHA-256 hash storage (7d exp)
Server-side RS256 JWKS verification of Google ID tokens
7-step atomic progression, draft data, state recovery
Education, Experience, Skills, Projects, Links, Goals
Dynamic completion score % based on profile sections
Candidate inactivity tracker; schedules reminders R1, R2, R3
Normalized M2M skill binding with levels (Beginner to Expert)
Work mode, salary expectations, target role, relocate
Regex rules for edu, experience, 60+ common tech skills
Candidate reviews & confirms parsed fields in wizard
Persists status, storage key, raw suggestions JSON
Job card DTOs, job detail queries, company branding
Faceted search (workMode, expLevel, title keywords, salary)
Skill overlap algorithm between Profile and Job.skills[]
applyToJob, duplicate prevention, resume ownership check
Captures resumeId, filename, and file size at submit time
Pipeline stage transition (Applied → Review → Interview → Offer)
Candidate details view & authorized resume file streaming
MCQ/Coding assessments, pass/fail grading, time limits
Formal offers (Draft, Sent, Accepted, Declined) with salary
Service packages (30, 45, 60 mins), pricing in INR, active flag
Weekly recurring rules (day, hours, tz) + date exceptions
Mentorship workspace, meeting URL, session notes, actions
Verified student reviews, star ratings (1-5), aggregate score
Platform-wide job post moderation & publishing overrides
Course modules, lessons (video, quiz, article, project)
Immutable AuditLog capture (actor, email, action, resource)
Aggregates user, mentor, job, and application KPIs
Dispatches 15+ rich HTML transactional email templates
Zoho ZeptoMail REST API v1.1 client with test fallback
Persists message status (SENT / FAILED) in MongoDB
Gotenberg container bridge for DOCX/HTML to PDF
MIME type, extension, and magic-byte signature validator
Local disk storage provider; S3 / R2 ready abstraction

svg.text: 4. PRISMA ORM DATA ACCESS LAYER & MONGODB PERSISTENCE
Prisma Client provides strong TypeScript typing, connection pooling, and MongoDB document mapping. All models use ObjectId primary keys.

g.text: User (_id, email, passwordHash, role, status, googleId)
Profile (_id, userId, candidateType, phone, location, bio)
Education (_id, profileId, institution, degree, field, years)
Experience (_id, profileId, company, roleTitle, dates, desc)
Skill & UserSkill (_id, profileId, skillId, level, verified)
Project (_id, profileId, title, technologies[], urls, role)
Resume (_id, profileId, filename, size, mime, status, extracted)
status: APPLIED, REVIEW, SHORTLIST, INTERVIEW, OFFER
Immutable Resume Reference: resumeId, filename, size
Screening answers JSON, coverNote, recruiter feedback
Company (_id, name, slug [unique], website, industry, verified)
Assessment (_id, companyId, jobId, title, type, passingScore)
salaryOffered, currency, status: DRAFT, SENT, ACCEPTED
Mentor (_id, userId, name, email, domain, rating, price)
Course, Module & Lesson (_id, slug, type, duration)

svg.text: External dependencies communicating over HTTPS REST or Docker container bridges. Clearly distinguishes live implementations from planned roadmap items.

g.text: • Indexed keys: status, publishedAt, email, companyId, tokenHash
• Dispatches Candidate confirm, Recruiter alert, Team invites, Setup tokens
• StorageFactory: Plug-and-play abstraction ready for AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2
• Authentication: Protected with Bearer CRON_SECRET or Admin session
• AI / LLM Integration: Planned Gemini / OpenAI for resume parsing
• Object Storage: Migration to AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 bucket
• Payment Gateway: Stripe / Razorpay for mentorship escrow & fees
Clients never hold DB credentials · Passwords bcrypt hashed (12 salt rounds) · Multi-tenant company isolation enforced at server
